fn calculateDeposit(initial: Int, years: Int) -> Int
  requires (initial >= 0)
  requires (years >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (years == 0) then initial else (calculateDeposit(initial, (years - 1)) + (calculateDeposit(initial, (years - 1)) / 100))))
  effects pure
  example (calculateDeposit(0, 0) == 0)
{
  if (years == 0) then initial else (calculateDeposit(initial, (years - 1)) + (calculateDeposit(initial, (years - 1)) / 100))
}

fn solve(X: Int) -> Int
  requires (X >= 101)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures (calculateDeposit(100, result) >= X)
  ensures ((result == 0) or (calculateDeposit(100, (result - 1)) < X))
  effects pure
  example (solve(0) == 0)
{
  0
}
